about.heading: About GEZE
about.paragraph1: The family-owned business GEZE began its operations in 1863. Over 160 years, the company has proven the quality of its products and services worldwide by utilizing innovative technologies in automatic doors, windows, and building automation, becoming a globally recognized name.
about.paragraph2: More than 3,000 employees work in GEZE branches around the world. The company has local offices in 37 countries and provides services to customers globally. All GEZE products are manufactured in compliance with international standards and hold globally recognized certifications.

collaboration.text: Persia Automatic Door Company, by maintaining consistency in service and product quality, remains dynamic and forward-looking toward new market developments. Our goal is to become a leading brand in the automatic door industry through continuous innovation, contributing to improved quality of life and safety while enhancing traffic infrastructure.

representative.subtitle: Official Representative of GEZE Products in Iran

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Government Facilities)
hero.text: In government buildings and public facilities, selecting automatic doors is considered part of the security infrastructure. These environments host a high volume of employees, visitors, and clients on a daily basis, and even minor system disruptions can impact building security. By leveraging advanced GEZE technologies, PersiaDoor provides specialized solutions to enhance security, manage traffic flow, and ensure optimal performance in government facilities.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Help Your Organization?

security.title: Access Security
security.text: In ministries, organizations, and government offices, data security and access control are critical. By utilizing GEZE automatic door technologies, PersiaDoor enables seamless integration of doors with access control systems.

accessibility.title: Traffic Management
accessibility.text: During office hours, the high volume of employee and visitor traffic requires fast and intelligent systems. GEZE doors, equipped with precise sensors, high-speed operation, and configurable settings, effectively manage pedestrian flow and prevent congestion or queues.

efficiency.title: 24/7 Service and Support
efficiency.text: Through periodic maintenance, round-the-clock support, and rapid on-site response, PersiaDoor ensures that installed systems operate at peak performance—even during peak hours—without interruption.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Private Facilities)
hero.text: GEZE automatic doors can be used in large residential complexes, towers, automobile showrooms, and similar environments. Aesthetics and security are of particular importance in these spaces. Therefore, PersiaDoor offers specially designed doors—such as decorative pivot hinged doors—to harmonize with the overall architectural design. GEZE products prioritize decorative appeal, enhanced security, and reliable emergency exit solutions for private facilities.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Traffic Management and Security
hygiene.text: In residential complexes and large retail spaces, security is a top priority. PersiaDoor provides solutions that ensure safe and controlled access. Automatic doors equipped with appropriate sensors enhance overall security and protect the premises.

easyAccess.title: Decorative Design
easyAccess.text: GEZE automatic doors can be manufactured using materials such as stone and wood, allowing them to align seamlessly with the overall architectural design. These doors are custom-designed and produced in various dimensions to meet specific aesthetic requirements.

accessControl.title: Emergency Exit
accessControl.text: Automatic doors with self-locking capabilities enhance space security and, in emergency situations such as fires or the prevention of smoke and toxic gas intrusion, help ensure the safety and well-being of occupants.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Shopping Centers)
hero.text: GEZE automatic doors are an ideal solution for shopping centers, malls, and large hypermarkets across Iran. These doors are not limited to entry and exit functions; they are an integral part of space management infrastructure. Considering the unique architecture and design of shopping centers, and with a focus on aesthetics and performance, PersiaDoor delivers solutions tailored to customer needs. Modern automatic door designs aim to enhance customer convenience, manage pedestrian traffic efficiently, optimize energy consumption, ensure security, and provide reliable emergency exits.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Traffic Management and Security
hygiene.text: During peak hours, automatic doors equipped with precise sensors prevent crowd congestion and ensure smooth and orderly pedestrian flow.

easyAccess.title: Energy Optimization
easyAccess.text: Automatic doors in shopping centers contribute to energy optimization by reducing heating, cooling, and ventilation costs.

accessControl.title: Emergency Exit
accessControl.text: Automatic doors with self-locking capabilities enhance space security and, in emergency situations such as fires or smoke and toxic gas prevention, help ensure the safety and well-being of visitors.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Bus Terminals & Railway Stations)
hero.text: Bus terminals and railway stations are among the busiest transportation hubs in the country—spaces where thousands of people move every day. Therefore, door systems must ensure safe, fast, and well-organized pedestrian flow. PersiaDoor, leveraging GEZE automatic door technologies, delivers specialized solutions specifically designed for high-traffic environments.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Traffic Management
hygiene.text: During peak hours, railway stations and terminals experience extremely high foot traffic. GEZE automatic doors, equipped with precise sensors and adjustable configurations, manage passenger entry and exit smoothly without congestion.

easyAccess.title: Flexible Design and Custom Dimensions
easyAccess.text: Terminals and stations differ in layout and space requirements. Some require wide entrances, while others need narrower access points. GEZE doors, with custom dimensions, durable profiles, and specialized designs, integrate seamlessly with waiting halls, corridors, gates, and main entrances.

accessControl.title: Service and Support
accessControl.text: Transportation hubs operate continuously, and entrances and exits must function 24/7. Persia Service ensures uninterrupted performance through scheduled maintenance and round-the-clock support, maintaining both security and traffic flow at all times.

services.title: 24/7 Service and Support
services.text: Persia Service provides periodic inspections and 24/7 support to guarantee the reliable operation of door systems at all times. In such environments, door malfunctions can disrupt the entire traffic flow, making durability and system quality critically important.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Airports)
hero.text: Airports are among the most sensitive and high-traffic facilities in any country—where security, speed, and uninterrupted operation are critically important. As the exclusive representative of GEZE Germany, PersiaDoor delivers specialized solutions for intelligent entrance management and access control in airport environments. Automatic door systems are capable of handling extremely high volumes of passenger traffic efficiently and safely.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Fast and Smooth Passenger Flow
hygiene.text: In airports, managing passenger movement at entrances, exits, and transit corridors is vital. GEZE doors, equipped with precise sensors, fast response times, and adjustable configurations, guide passenger flow smoothly without congestion or disruption.

easyAccess.title: Secure Access Control
easyAccess.text: Due to high security requirements, airports demand highly reliable entrance and exit systems. Based on installation locations, emergency routes, and specific security needs, PersiaDoor equips and configures doors with certified safety standards, locking mechanisms, protective systems, and specialized access control solutions.

accessControl.title: Service and Support
accessControl.text: Airports operate around the clock, and entrances and exits must function 24/7. Through scheduled maintenance and continuous support, the Persia Service team ensures uninterrupted performance of automatic doors at all times, maintaining both security and traffic efficiency.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Banks)
hero.text: In banking environments, selecting and installing automatic doors is not merely a technical decision; it is a strategic factor in enhancing security, operational efficiency, and customer experience. In such high-sensitivity spaces, doors must deliver reliable design, mechanical performance, safety, and access control—especially during peak hours.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Fast and Smooth Traffic Flow
hygiene.text: As banks are among the most high-traffic environments, even minor disruptions in door performance can lead to serious operational issues. Automatic doors equipped with precise and reliable sensors ensure smooth movement and prevent congestion.

easyAccess.title: Secure Access Control
easyAccess.text: The security requirements of banks are not comparable to other environments. By assessing the location and specific needs of each branch, PersiaDoor delivers tailored security solutions—from access control configurations to equipping doors with certified safety and protection systems.

accessControl.title: Service and Support
accessControl.text: Continuous and reliable operation of GEZE automatic doors during banking hours is essential. For this reason, scheduled maintenance and 24/7 support are considered dedicated services for the banking sector. PersiaDoor is a trusted partner for ensuring security and rapid service delivery in banks.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Factories)
hero.text: Factories are high-traffic environments with strict safety requirements. In such settings, selecting the right door system has a direct impact on employee safety and operational efficiency. PersiaDoor delivers specialized solutions using GEZE automatic doors—products designed in accordance with international standards and optimized for industrial environments.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: High-Level Security
hygiene.text: GEZE automatic doors, equipped with intelligent and secure locking systems, restrict unauthorized access and enable rapid evacuation of personnel during emergency situations.

easyAccess.title: Traffic Management
easyAccess.text: Precise sensors and adjustable control systems regulate door opening and closing for smooth and continuous movement of people. This reduces unnecessary توقف‌ها, increases workflow speed, and ensures long-term reliability with minimal wear—making these doors ideal for production environments.

accessControl.title: Emergency Exit
accessControl.text: GEZE automatic doors feature advanced safety systems and can function as emergency exits. They are engineered to operate safely and reliably during power outages or emergency conditions.

fireSafety.title: Durability, Performance, and Reliability
fireSafety.text: The superior build quality of GEZE automatic doors ensures resistance to dust, vibration, and temperature fluctuations. As a result, these doors maintain stable performance with minimal wear, even under continuous and heavy-duty operation.

hero.title: Industry Solutions (Hospitals)
hero.text: With a deep understanding of hospital environments, PersiaDoor delivers specialized hospital door solutions that address operational challenges while ensuring maximum safety and hygiene standards. Hospital doors are designed to provide smooth, barrier-free access and, due to minimal contact operation, help maintain a hygienic environment. These doors also offer sufficient opening width for hospital beds and, when closed, significantly limit air flow to support controlled clinical conditions.

howSection.title: How Do Automatic Doors Support Your Business?

hygiene.title: Hygienic Standards
hygiene.text: Hygienic and Hermetic hospital automatic doors, compliant with the highest healthcare standards, are an ideal solution for sensitive medical environments. By minimizing contact points and eliminating the need for manual handles, these doors enhance hygiene while advanced sensors ensure user safety.

easyAccess.title: Easy and Fast Access
easyAccess.text: Automatic doors facilitate smooth entry and exit for all users—especially patients using wheelchairs or stretchers. In high-traffic hospital areas, these systems reduce congestion and significantly shorten waiting times.

accessControl.title: Emergency Exit
accessControl.text: Hospital emergency exit doors prevent the spread of smoke and toxic gases during fire incidents. When connected to fire alarm systems, they close automatically, and in the event of power failure, they integrate with emergency lighting to ensure safe evacuation routes. Break-out door systems also allow manual outward opening when required.

fireSafety.title: 24/7 Service and Support
fireSafety.text: Through regular maintenance programs, round-the-clock support, and rapid on-site response, PersiaDoor ensures that installed systems operate reliably and without interruption—even during peak hospital activity.
